strings: The sky opens up on the patrol and the cats are left scrambling for shelter. They end up huddling in POI in an attempt to stay dry and the original goals of this patrol are forgotten.

The sky opens up on the patrol and p_l yells for the patrol to find higher ground. Luckily POI is near and the cats huddle atop it. They end up drenched, but safe from the flash flood they watch ravage the landscape. Unfortunately, the border must go unpatrolled for today.

There is a downpour, and a sudden flood from the overflowing river sweeps all of the cats in the patrol away. Some of the patrol manage to pull themselves back to solid ground before they're swept too far, but others are found later on the banks of POI, battered half to death.
